Specification: This module defines an instrumented and configurable variant of the EWD998 channel-based termination-detection specification for use with TLC trace generation and statistics collection. It adds feature-flag controlled optimizations to token passing, constrains initial simulation states to realistic ones, and defines a behavior specification in which system steps and environment steps evolve under the inherited variables from the base module. The file also configures TLC to run in generation mode, disables deadlock checking because termination is expected, records when termination occurs, and writes per-behavior measurements such as action counts and delay between environment termination and detection to a CSV output.
IfThenElse: IF EWD998!Termination # EWD998!Termination' THEN TLCSet(1, TLCGet("level")) ELSE TRUE
CaseExpr: CASE "pt3" \in F /\ color[n] = "black" -> 0 [] "pt4" \in F /\ tkn.color ="black" -> 0 [] OTHER -> n-1

[tkn EXCEPT !.q = tkn.q + counter[n], !.color = IF color[n] = "black" THEN "black" ELSE tkn.color]
